normalized_requirement: Add optional per-link expiry (expires_at, UTC, set at creation, future timestamps only). Existing links never expire. An expired link's redirect returns 410 Gone and does not increment the click count; stats remain readable and expose expiry status. No new visitor-identity analytics.
assumptions: Additive nullable expires_at column; NULL means never expires.
Only aggregate click counts are required; no visitor tracking.

acceptance_criteria.statement: POST /api/links accepts optional future expires_at; past/invalid timestamps return 422.
An expired link's GET/HEAD /r/{code} returns 410 and does not increment click_count.
Stats remain readable for expired links and expose status active/expired.
The additive migration preserves existing rows and click counts.

notes: Requirement revised: expired-link response changed from 404 to 410 Gone.
